title: WP_REST_API_View_Config_View_Base
description: The view configuration properties shared by all view types.

filters.description: The filters applied to the view.

value.description: The value to filter by. Its type depends on the field and the operator.

sort.description: The sort applied to the view.

perPage.description: The number of items shown per page.

fields.description: The fields shown in the view.

titleField.description: The field used as the item title.

mediaField.description: The field used as the item media.

descriptionField.description: The field used as the item description.

showTitle.description: Whether the title field is shown.

showMedia.description: Whether the media field is shown.

showDescription.description: Whether the description field is shown.

groupBy.description: The grouping applied to the view.
